name: Aarakocra

playerHandbook.rules: Tables 1, 2, 3, 14, 20–21, 44–45, 53, 60 and Appendix 3, plus Chapter 9 combat.

movementOnly.detail: Land speed 6 only. The character entry gives Fly 36 (C).

sourceDistinctions: PHBR10 player profile. Later fifth-edition rules stay separate.
Use Chapter 2 creation ranges. Appendix Table 12 gives narrower Wisdom and Charisma maxima, and the NPC meets both sets of limits.

sourceDistinctions: PHBR10 player profile. Keep creature entries separate.
Chapter 2 gives Fighter and Druid as single-class choices. Appendix Table 13 separately lists Fighter/Shaman as a multiclass combination. The build uses the undisputed Fighter option.
PHBR10 gives fist damage without a special PC attack count. The sample uses one fist at the first-level fighter attack rate. The MC11 creature’s multiple attacks stay with that creature stat block.

name: Advanced Bullywug

playerHandbook.rules: Tables 1, 2, 3, 14, 20–21, 44–45, 53, 60 and Appendix 3, plus Chapter 9 combat.

movementOnly.detail: The main entry supplies Move 3, Swim 15 in unarmored form. The advanced subsection gives no different rates. The NPC borrows the unarmored rates, and swims with the shield slung.

sourceDistinctions: Printed heading Bullywug, Advanced. Separate from baseline Bullywug.
Book heading is Bullywug, Advanced. The staged catalog keeps the reviewed name Advanced Bullywug.
The basic Bullywug movement rates come from the Monstrous Manual. Its Advanced subsection gives no separate rates. The example wears no body armor. The shield is treated as slung while swimming.
